lesson.intro: El past perfect es el 'había hecho' del español: una acción anterior a otro momento del pasado. Es la base del tercer condicional y del estilo indirecto.
when: Una acción que ocurrió antes que otra acción pasada (When I got to the station, the train had already left).
Experiencias hasta un momento del pasado (I had never seen snow before I went to Canada).
Con by the time, already, just, never, before, after.
Ojo con el significado: 'When I arrived, the film started' (empezó al llegar yo) frente a 'When I arrived, the film had started' (ya había empezado).
Con after o before el orden ya está claro, así que a veces vale también el pasado simple (After she finished / had finished her homework, she went out).

form.label: Estructura
items: had + participio pasado (igual para todas las personas)

examples.en: When I got to the station, the train had already left.
examples.es: Cuando llegué a la estación, el tren ya se había ido.

examples.en: I had never seen snow before I went to Canada.
examples.es: Nunca había visto la nieve antes de ir a Canadá.

examples.en: By the time we arrived, the film had started.
examples.es: Para cuando llegamos, la película había empezado.

examples.en: She was hungry because she hadn't eaten all day.
examples.es: Tenía hambre porque no había comido en todo el día.

errors.wrong: When I arrived, the train already left.
errors.right: When I arrived, the train had already left.
errors.why: La salida del tren es anterior a tu llegada: past perfect.
Después de had va el participio (gone), no el pasado (went).
En inglés no se usan dos negaciones: had never o hadn't ever.

lesson.tip: Dibuja una línea del tiempo: si hay dos momentos pasados y quieres marcar el que pasó antes, ese va con had + participio.

checks.explain: Se fueron antes de que llegaras: had gone.
Experiencia anterior a un momento pasado: had never met.

checks.prompt: She couldn't pay because she ___ her wallet.
checks.explain: Perdió la cartera antes de intentar pagar: had lost.

practice.prompt: When we got to the cinema, the film ___, so we missed the beginning.
practice.explain: Ya había empezado antes de llegar: had started.

practice.prompt: I didn't recognise him because he ___ (change) a lot.
answers: had changed
practice.explain: El cambio ocurrió antes de verle: had changed.

practice.prompt: She ___ (never / fly) before her trip to London last year.
answers: had never flown
practice.explain: Experiencia anterior a un momento pasado: had never + participio (flown).

practice.sentence: When I arrived, everyone had went home.
answers: When I arrived, everyone had gone home.

practice.sentence: I was nervous because I never gave a speech before.
answers: I was nervous because I had never given a speech before.
practice.explain: Experiencia anterior al momento de los nervios: had never given.

answers: The bus had already left.
practice.explain: 'Already' va entre had y el participio.

practice.es: Cuando llegué, ya se habían ido.
answers: When I arrived, they had already left.
When I arrived, they had already gone.
When I got there, they had already left.
When I got there, they had already gone.
practice.explain: 'Se habían ido' antes de llegar: had already left/gone.

practice.prompt: By the time the police arrived, the thief ___.
practice.explain: By the time + pasado suele llevar past perfect en la otra parte.

practice.prompt: After she ___ (finish) her homework, she went out.
answers: had finished
finished
practice.explain: Con 'after' el orden está claro: valen had finished y finished.

answers: I had never seen the sea.
I'd never seen the sea.
I had never seen the ocean.
practice.explain: 'Había visto' = had seen; never va en medio.

challenge.sentence: The meeting started before I arrived.
answers: had already started
had already begun
challenge.explain: Ocurrió antes de llegar: had already + participio.

challenge.sentence: It was my first visit to New York.
answers: had never been
challenge.explain: 'Mi primera visita' = nunca había estado antes: had never been.

challenge.sentence: When I got home, my parents already went to bed.
answers: When I got home, my parents had already gone to bed.
challenge.explain: Se acostaron antes de que llegaras: had already gone.

challenge.prompt: The streets were wet because it ___ (rain) during the night.
answers: had rained
had been raining
challenge.explain: Llovió antes del momento en que viste las calles: had rained (o had been raining).

challenge.es: No había estudiado, así que suspendí el examen.
answers: I hadn't studied, so I failed the exam.
I hadn't studied, so I failed the test.
challenge.explain: Acción anterior (hadn't studied) y resultado en pasado simple (failed).
